parsed.why: Low-risk tier locally: no adult facility ban, gender-identity discrimination protections with working commission, X licences, sanctuary-care city shielding travellers; well above national line despite national framework and hate-crime gap.

Enforced criminal performance ban, birth-sex facility/shelter/prison mandates, indecent-exposure exposure, trans-killing rate above national homicide baseline, panic defence, police indifference — organised-law hostility near High Risk.

Do-Not-Travel tier: birth-sex facility law with criminal penalties plus private bounty suits, licence invalidation actively enforced with no grace period; universal-exposure state measures over a hostile national baseline.

Moderate tier: no adult facility or care ban, protections in four municipalities covering ~46%; but no state nondiscrimination, hate-crime gap, and youth-targeting board actions — slightly above national line.

Escalating tier: 2026 school/college birth-sex bathroom ban, inmate treatment freeze-frame, no hate-crime law; documented facility exposure below national average but under the enforcement-heavy hostile states.
